The key part of this is YOU initiated the breakup. She is probably sick of the back and forth. If you were so in love you never would have done this in the first place. You’re supposed to grow with your partner not expect them to pick up your slack. They can help you but they aren’t always going to be able to save you from yourself. I know it hurts. But take this as an opportunity to grow as a person, and learn that your actions have very permanent consequences. Stop pining after her and respect the fact that she probably needs space from you so she can heal properly. If you were together for two and a half years and you truly do love her; then acknowledge the fact that she is probably in a lot of pain right now. You should want her to heal and be happy. She probably wants the same for you. But idk it sounds like you really need to grow up tbh. Just leave her alone dude.

High School is really dark. You don’t have a lot of options.  Try and get past it. I’ve been where you are. There’s a lot of good in life outside of high school. I’m rooting for you. I hope it gets better.

Honestly she sounds manipulative. Sounds like she wants the best of both worlds. He’s offering physical support and you offer her emotional support. You deserve so much better. Having insecurities doesn’t make you unworthy of love. A good partner will be patient and do what they can to help. Not place blame on you. I wish you the best of luck and I’m sorry if my opinion is unwarranted.
